violation_type.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))
violation_type.short_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.
An incident report was not generated and shared with the parent once the operation learned the child was evaluated by health care professionals for a sustained injury.
This standard was evaluated during the investigation and was found to be deficient. The operation did not share a copy of an incident report with the parent within two days of the incident occurring.
The operation failed to complete/document an incident report after being notified of the medical diagnosis.
A child received an injury that required medical attention and the Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form was not utilized to document the injury.

An incident report was completed for an injury that occurred in care after a parent inquired about an injury that occurred in care that they took their child to a healthcare professional to be seen for, but it was not the HHSC Incident report and did not include all the required information.
